requested_changes.title: Rejects the real multi-row CLI JSONL success stream
requested_changes.description: The runner requires the entire stdout JSONL to contain exactly one summary. Real --output jsonl uses default emit=outJSON and emits each verified session.event before cliFlowSummary. A normal MODEL→TOOL→MODEL turn is rejected after side effects.
requested_changes.fix: Accept exactly one final command summary at the tail, bind finite preceding genuine event rows to admitted/final session/protocol/build/cursor and relevant Run, preserve all raw rows, reject unknown/foreign/order/replay/duplicate/trailing records. EVENT_RESYNC_REQUIRED is a nonzero recovery path. Do not disable/strip streaming or invent a single-row normal positive.
required_controls: real-shaped multi-event run positive with RUN_STATE and AVAILABLE ARTIFACT settlement
unknown/foreign/out-of-order event, duplicate summary, trailing row, snapshot-resync nonzero negatives

requested_changes.title: Bootstrap zero provider count is asserted after a non-draft execution without evidence
requested_changes.description: Bootstrap invokes goal without --draft. verbSteps defaults start_as_draft=false and the real CLI follows execution to a terminal Run. The runner then hardcodes provider_requests=0 without deriving the bootstrap Goal/Run MODEL effects or provider originals. Execute trusts that field. A hypothetical local zero-provider Runtime does not establish the claimed zero count for all admitted bootstrap paths.
requested_changes.fix: Freeze bootstrap as an explicit no-execution DRAFT creation and bind its actual admission/config witnesses, or bind and meter any non-draft Run's complete original MODEL/provider facts and revise the finite Root request partition. Keep the qualification1+ordinary2 limit; do not count a synthetic positive as a zero-provider witness.
required_controls: actual-shaped bootstrap DRAFT positive preserving saved context
non-draft bootstrap with MODEL facts rejected unless independently budgeted and evidenced
bootstrap receipt zero cannot be supplied merely by hardcoded field

requested_changes.title: Successful normal turn is required to use the previous bootstrap Goal
requested_changes.description: doc.goal_id is tied to bootstrap.goal_id. The persisted bootstrap session is nonempty. Normal run performs session.get then session.send, and cli_stream explicitly rejects an admitted Goal equal to the previous snapshot Goal. Therefore a successful ordinary turn necessarily creates a new Goal and later fails task.goal_id==doc.goal_id after its actual SDK turn.
requested_changes.fix: Derive the ordinary new Goal/Task/Run from the same raw original admission/final execution and corresponding DB objects. Keep bootstrap Goal as historical input, verify the new Goal's actual effective budget chain and Root allowed generated-output identity, and reject foreign/missing/replaced Task/Run. Do not forge an equal old/new Goal snapshot or relax the check to any Run.
required_controls: same-session successful new-Goal admission binds its exact Task/Run
old-Goal positive rejected by native admission invariant
foreign Goal/Task/Run and mismatched effective-budget negatives
